How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
We currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process an order before it ships. For addresses in the contiguous U.S., shipping then typically takes 1–7 days, depending on the destination: 1–3 days on the West Coast and 5–7 days on the East Coast.
These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates. You’ll receive tracking by email when your order is ready to ship. See our Shipping & Delivery page for details.
